Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy describes how Refined Auto Detailing collects, uses, and shares information about you when you use our website or services.

We collect contact information (name, email, phone) only when you submit a quote request or contact form. This information is used solely to respond to your inquiry and schedule your detailing service.

We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties. Your information is kept confidential and used only for service delivery.

For any privacy questions, contact us at info@refinedautodetailing.com.
